title: crocus kotschyanus subsp. suworowianus
intro: Crocus kotschyanus subsp. suworowianus, commonly known as the autumn-flowering crocus, is a species of flowering plant in the genus Crocus. This plant is used in traditional medicine and has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Crocus kotschyanus subsp. suworowianus include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, improve mood, and exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
